_about: Hosts the console offers when adding a model provider, and published prices for hosts whose model list has none (OpenRouter's list carries its own). Prices are USD per million tokens, standard tier, prompts up to 200k tokens; image models price their image output as output tokens. An operator's price in config always wins, and a model not listed here stays 'unknown'. 'image_input' names the chat models of that family that accept pictures as input (the families' own docs), for lists that do not say so (OpenAI's and Gemini's list names only); the vision budget uses it, and a model not named stays 'unknown', never 'no'. Update the date and numbers together.

hosts.name: Google Gemini
hosts._about_model_efforts: Gemini API thinking guide, thinking levels table (read 2026-11-02): no Gemini 3.x/4 model lists a 'none' level, so none is sent as the lowest listed level instead of spending a refused call.

hosts.name: OpenAI
hosts._about_gpt6: OpenAI GPT-6 guide, Migration section (read 2026-11-02): 'GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol do not support none; use low instead.' and 'GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6.1 Terra support Chat Completions, but tool calling requires Responses.' This adapter has no Responses path yet, so those models answer without the tool loop.

hosts.name: NanoGPT
hosts._about_rerank: https://docs.nano-gpt.com (Rerank, checked 2026-11-03): POST /api/v1/rerank takes 1-1,024 documents; relevance_score is a raw logit that can be negative, so it is mapped to 0..1. Models: GET /api/v1/rerank-models.

batch._about: https://docs.nano-gpt.com/api-reference/endpoint/batches (checked 2026-11-02): OpenAI, Claude and Gemini rows are billed at half the live price; open-source rows (gpt-oss included) run through normal routing at the normal price or less, so they are counted at the live price.

_about_reference: A model whose host lists no price is matched by name (the part after the last '/', without ':variant') against this public list, which needs no key. Resellers such as CometAPI bill a share of the model's official price, so the reference price keeps budgets on the safe side instead of counting the calls as free.

anthropic._about: Third column: a prompt-cache read, 0.1x the input price. A cache write costs 1.25x the input price (cacheWriteFactor in openai.go); masamong sends no cache_control yet, so neither appears today. Haiku 5.5 bills a prompt over 100k tokens at $0.50/$2.50; masamong's prompts stay far below that.

_about_recommend: What 'fill roles from this provider' picks: per role, the newest released model whose ID has every 'has' part and no 'not' part (a preview only when no release matches). Roles a host cannot serve (rerank on Gemini and OpenAI) are left as they are. Rules are looked up by the listed host's id first (cometapi, nanogpt: resellers whose lists mix every vendor), then by the family. CometAPI's embedding pick is qwen3-embedding-8b, the model the memory recipe was measured with.
_about_embed_widths: Embedding models known to be trained so the leading part of a vector is a usable vector of its own (Matryoshka / MRL), with their full width. Only these are cut to a narrower width (models.embed.dimensions; the default for them is 1024, measured 2026-10-13 in docs/rag/embedding-width-2026-10.md). A model not listed keeps its full width: cutting a model that was not trained for it ruins its search quality. Keys are matched by ReferenceName (lower case, after the last '/', without ':variant'). Sources: the Qwen3-Embedding model card (MRL, 32 up to the full width), OpenAI's embeddings guide (text-embedding-3 'dimensions'), Google's Gemini embeddings guide (gemini-embedding-001 output_dimensionality; gemini-embedding-2: MRL, default 3072, truncated widths auto-normalized). The guide recommends task prefixes for gemini-embedding-2 text ('task: search result | query: …'); none are added, which would change retrieval and break sandbox parity.
